promptSet.title: Approachable Tech Founder Profile Picture
promptSet.prompt: High-resolution headshot portrait of a confident technology founder with a warm smile, wearing a minimalist black turtleneck. Shot on Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.2 lens. Soft directional morning light, gentle natural shadows, sharp focus on iris, clean matte studio backdrop.
instructions: Open Google Gemini and ensure image generation is enabled.
Paste this portrait prompt template and personalize eye color or hair style.
Crop to square aspect ratio and update your founder profile.
promptSet.exampleOutput: Studio-caliber portrait with lifelike eye catchlights and crisp optical focus.
